claims.object_text: regulates transport of ATG-9 to coordinate autophagosome formation
claims.quote: KIF1A/UNC-104 coordinates localized autophagosome formation by regulating the transport of the integral membrane autophagy protein, ATG-9.

claims.object_text: synaptic vesicle kinesin required for localization of autophagosome biogenesis near synapses
claims.quote: this localization depends on the synaptic vesicle kinesin, KIF1A/UNC-104.

claims.object_text: regulates neurodevelopment via ATG-9 transport and spatial regulation of autophagy
claims.quote: autophagy is spatially regulated in neurons through the transport of ATG-9 by KIF1A/UNC-104 to regulate neurodevelopment.
